name: seekhunt
description: Real-life hide and seek with a battle-royale zone that closes in. A web app for your phone, no install needed.
author: Nouh Khouyi

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @seekhunt/server" "npm run dev -w @seekhunt/web"
scripts.dev:phone: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @seekhunt/server" "npm run dev:phone -w @seekhunt/web"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @seekhunt/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
